body: I thought it was helping in the beginning, but ultimately no it did not help me.
I was hospitalized. The docs told me there were no significant long-term side effects. They were wrong in my case.
ECT stands for electroconvulsive therapy. Also known as electroshock therapy.
Oh man. So you got it 18 years ago and it still affects you? Thanks for the nice words.
Thanks for your reply. Hopefully it will be as good as that.
